author: @josietanner3960
text: I have only been playing for a few days on Xbox one, but I am impressed by some things and not impressed by others. I grew up playing the old Harry Potter games. I have read the whole series several times, and I used to have the first 2 movies memorized, so I would say that I am a Harry Potter fan. To me this did not feel like Hogwarts. The exterior of the castle looked like Hogwarts, but the interior does not feel nor look like Hogwarts in my opinion. I was disappointed that you cannot talk to characters unless they are part of a quest. What is the point of having an open world? I thought that the story line was weak. I thought that it would have been better to start as a first year and work your way up to a seventh year like Harry did. I was really disappointed that there was no Quidditch in the game. Even the old Harry Potter games had Quidditch. In the books AND the movies there was no surrounding town near Hogwarts. Hogwarts was protected by an enchanted fence and then there was Hogsmeade and that was it. They added additional things in there that I thought were unnecessary, but they probably did it as a dig towards JK Rowing because of her stance at the time.However, there are good things about this game. I do think that the graphics are amazing. The fighting is challenging. There are numerous places to explore. You can catch and have pets like in Fantastic Beasts. You can also ride some beasts. And the classes are fun.
